requested_minimal_reproduction.main_request: Identify original leaf number with 卷20〈改造漏刻〉heading and, if available, the full passage through the next heading including leaf recto/verso; provide copy-specific shelfmark, physical edition/impression identifiers and authorized surrogate access conditions.

provenance_minimum: edition/impression basis distinguished from inherited preface
photographic/scan source URI or institution-provided delivery record
source bytes SHA256 and target image bytes SHA256 once received
human visual collation of all four distinct target loci
independent image-to-item binding and handling/publication permission
proposed_contact_sequence: Use Tokyo institutional public email for a non-binding copy-specific item inquiry only after authorization; do not attach a claim of user affiliation.
Use Kyoto University Letters Library officially routed contact after verifying its current address rather than inventing a personal address.
Ask separately about availability, minimal article folio, preexisting permitted surrogate, copy method, fees, page count, permissions, and holder/impression identification.
If originals are made available, bind the image to each individual item before mechanical or transmission adjudication.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Cataloged volumes from four physical copies are not themselves four independent attestations of the target article
An inquiry email, if later sent, is not a digitized original or a transmission edge
remaining_lineage_questions: Can any holder provide an item-bound physical folio or clear high-resolution authorized image?
Can a directly collated impression-dated print be separated from copied early preface dates?
